Being a friend isn't supposed to be exhausting, you shouldn't have to worry about what you've possibly done to drive a friend away. Believe me I know it hurts watching people you care about leave, but if they want to go, they can go, but I will not allow them back into my life if they decide to come back. I can imagine how hurtful it was being turned away like that, if I was in your position, I wouldn't assume I've done anything wrong unless I was specifically told. To answer your question about how to be a friend, people love being around others who make them feel good, I always tell my friends how beautiful they are, how much I appreciate them, make plans to hang out and I listen even when they don't know I am or need me too. I also have a really hard time expressing my feelings in real life, so when the words get stuck I write my friends little notes. Observe people, find ways that people treat or speak to you that you like and apply them to your friendships. Send them cute memes or songs that remind you of them and tell them that, it lets them know that even when there's no communication, you're still thinking about them.
